ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels to 25% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly high-intensity white lobes with low-intensity black pigmentation concentrated along the entire trailing edge boundary, the central fluke junction, and as discrete linear marks across the interior lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 55-65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge topography with high-frequency, variable-amplitude serrations and several deep, distinct notches isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Slightly convex sweep trajectory along the upper margin of the lobes, terminating in heavily textured and irregularly shaped distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular low-intensity pixel nodes (barnacle colonization) localized on the distal tips and along the upper trailing margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive detection of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white pigmentation on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent rake marks across the interior lobes; significant irregular scarring and physical texture anomalies along the distal trailing edges.
other_distinctive_markers: A single, highly distinct circular black focal spot located in the upper-middle region of the left lobe.
